      "observations": [
        "Moves new-mail sound handling from nsStatusBarBiffManager C++ into the JS manager; removes the C++ service, interface and build entries. Chat and preference previews call the common playback API.",
        "Custom file audio reuses a weak Audio reference, pauses a different custom URL, restarts currentTime and pauses on shutdown. The system-sound branch returns before custom-audio cleanup. The broad JSDoc statement that an already playing sound is stopped must not be reused as a guarantee for every branch.",
        "New sound/browser preference tests use MockSound and notification-audio-ended. Sixteen added Assert.ok/Assert.equal calls in the chat/general preference sound tasks lack message arguments. This violates the current assertion-message requirement and is not an accepted test pattern. Tests were read, not run.",
        "Bug1973448 describes unifying sound and visual notification handling and avoiding custom-format limits of nsISound. Expected unchanged behavior and the release-note denial are intent/judgment. Review D254653 reports Windows11 scenario success before initial landing 2c7959b53377, then test-failure backout4f6bda552057, later lint failures, an author missing-audio-file statement, and reland877418d0142a. The later missing-file and lint statements do not establish the initial backout cause.",
        "The new browser_sounds direct-call task sets both mail and feed enablement Booleans true; its summary says playback should work even when false, but that task does not directly test the false case. The helper contract is supported by the implementation and direct preview callers. System assertions check the mocked event string; custom assertions check zero system calls and the ended Audio source URL. The negative helper watches notification-audio-ended during a one-second race; it does not establish indefinite silence."
